snippet.title: Morbid Metal: Early Access Launch Trailer - Now on Steam!
snippet.description:
Morbid Metal is now available on Steam. Save 25% with a special launch discount.
🔗 Play now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866130

Morbid Metal is a stylish fast paced hack and slash roguelite set in a dark sci fi world. Switch characters instantly mid fight to chain abilities into devastating combos and tear through waves of lethal machines. Take risks to gain power and build momentum as you face cinematic, challenging bosses. Death is how you evolve. Break through the simulation.

🔗 Steam Page here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1866130/Morbid_Metal/

Developed by Screenjuice in Unity and published by Ubisoft.
Music My Blue Stahli.
🔻 Follow the game for updates and exclusive content! 🔻
📌X: https://x.com/MorbidMetalGame
📌 BlueSky: https://web-cdn.bsky.app/profile/screen-juice.com
📌 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/morbidmetal.game/
📌 Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@morbidmetalgame
📌 Discord: https://t.co/iUhDCDVTyf
#Ubisoft #MorbidMetal 

We’re excited to work closely with our players to build the best possible version of Morbid Metal during Early Access.
Join us, become part of the community, experience the game as it evolves, and help shape its future along the way. ⚔️

Learn more about Ubisoft: www.ubisoftgroup.com
